impact: When the ChatGPT tier rejects a model, classifyCodexError emits a hardcoded tip (src/backends/codex.ts:57-59): 'Fall back to gpt-5.4 by setting "model": "gpt-5.4"'. Live repro with model=gpt-5.4 produced: 'Model "gpt-5.4" is not supported ... Fall back to gpt-5.4 by setting "model": "gpt-5.4"' — i.e. it tells the user to fall back to the exact model that just failed, because the fallback model is hardcoded regardless of which model failed. Fix: recommend a model OTHER than the failing one (don't suggest the failed model), and — now that multi-provider exists — suggest switching to the Gemini backend ("provider": "gemini") as an out-of-usage escape hatch. Ties into the failover feature.
resolution: Fixed in classifyError (src/backends/codex.ts): the model-not-supported tip now recommends a model OTHER than the one that failed (altModel = gpt-5.5 unless that was the failing model, else gpt-5.4) and points at the Gemini backend ("provider": "gemini"). No longer tells a failing gpt-5.4 to fall back to gpt-5.4. Commit 09fa68e; covered by codex.test.ts "never recommends the failing model in the fallback tip (ISS-009)".
title: Codex MODEL_ERROR fallback tip is circular — recommends the model that just failed
